name: Apotea AB
summary: Apotea AB (publ) operates an online pharmacy in Sweden. The company offers products in the areas of allergy, face, child and parent, bite and sting, preparedness, animal, fever and aches, cold, home and household, aid, hair removal and shaving, hair care, hands and feet, intimate, and dietary supplements. It also provides products in the categories of body care, stomach and intestine, food and drink, mouth and teeth, premium, trip, sex and lust, stop smoking, makeup, sun protection, wounds and injuries, sleep and sleep problems, training, weight control, vitamins and minerals, charity, and eyes and ears. In addition, the company offers services comprising leasing, leasing of personnel to related companies. and market contributions. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
